description: This file is a Java source class defining a REST controller for managing bookshelves in a book tracking application. It handles CRUD operations for both predefined and user-created shelves via HTTP endpoints.

classes.name: ShelfController
classes.description: REST controller managing shelves, providing endpoints for listing, creating, renaming, and deleting shelves.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all shelves (predefined and user-created) for the logged-in user.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new user-defined shelf. Returns appropriate HTTP responses based on success or validation errors.

methods.name: rename
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to rename an existing user-created shelf. Throws exceptions if shelves are not found or input is invalid.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a user-created shelf by name, with appropriate validation and responses.
